title_en: Buying Fish at the Seafood Market
Buying Fish at the Seafood Market
page_text_ocr_zh:
今天，我们全家到海鲜市场去买鱼。鱼摊上有各种鱼，有长长的鱼、扁扁的鱼，还有像炮弹和刀子形状的鱼，也有被切成一段一段，看不出原来模样的鱼。爸爸说，这些都是渔民刚从海里捕捞上来的，非常新鲜，我们可以多买一些鱼，也可以多认识一些鱼。

渔船捕到鱼以后，会载着新鲜的鱼回到渔港。所以，渔港的海鲜市场里卖的鱼，通常是最新鲜的，还有许多其他市场中看不到的鱼。

海鲜市场里有这么多鱼，真有趣！

逛海鲜市场，可以认识不同种类的鱼！

走！我们到每个摊位都去逛逛吧！
page_text_en:
Today, our whole family went to the seafood market to buy fish. There were all kinds of fish at the stall: long ones, flat ones, some shaped like bullets or knives, and others cut into pieces so you couldn't tell their original shape. Dad said these were all freshly caught by fishermen from the sea, very fresh. We could buy more fish and also learn to recognize more kinds.

After fishing boats catch fish, they carry the fresh fish back to the fishing port. So, the fish sold at the seafood market in the port are usually the freshest, and there are many kinds you can't find in other markets.

There are so many kinds of fish at the seafood market! How interesting!

Visiting the seafood market, we can learn about different kinds of fish!

Let's go! Let's visit every stall!
summary_zh: 一家人来到海鲜市场，看到各种各样的鱼，孩子们对丰富的鱼类感到兴奋，爸爸解释这些鱼是刚从海里捕捞上来的，非常新鲜，他们决定逛遍每个摊位。

过，因为水里的鱼用鳃呼吸，一旦离开水，鱼没办法呼吸就
会死掉。所以，把鱼放在冰块上，可以让鱼保持新鲜。

Fresh Fish Are Smooth and Shiny

I secretly touched the fish on the ice. It was slippery and sticky, as if coated
with something. Mom said, fish live in water, and their scales and mucus
help protect them, so fresh fish feel slippery. However, since fish breathe with gills, once out of water, they can't breathe and will die. Therefore, placing fish on ice helps keep them fresh.

Fins
When swimming, fish move their
fins to move forward
or turn.

Tail Fin
Anal Fin
Dorsal Fin

Lateral Line
Can sense water flow, water
temperature, and water pressure.

Gills
Inside the gill cover are the gills, which are the fish's respiratory organs. Fresh
fish gills are red. When fish gills turn coffee-colored, it means
the fish is no longer fresh.

Eyes
Fish eyes are protected by a transparent gel, without eyelids, so fish eyes don't close when they sleep.

Scales
Fish scales are like armor, protecting the fish's
skin and body.

title_en: Buying Fish at the Seafood Market
page_text_ocr_zh:
咦？这条鱼的尾巴像一把弯刀，好特别哦！

鱼尾巴的妙用

“咦？这条鱼的尾巴像一把弯刀，好特别哦！”
鱼摊上的鱼尾巴形状都不一样，爸爸说，旗鱼、金枪鱼和鬼头刀鱼（学名：鲯鳅）的尾鳍像弯刀，它们是海里的游泳健将，比圆形或扇形尾巴的鱼游得快，而且可以在大海中游好几百千米也不会累。

旗鱼、金枪鱼和鬼头刀鱼都是凶猛的肉食性鱼类。它们能用很快的速度追捕猎物，或是在海里长途旅行。

鱼向前游动时，最主要是靠尾巴的摆动。所以，不同形状的鱼尾，会影响鱼类的游泳能力。

弯刀形的尾巴
适合快速、长距离的海中旅行。

圆形和扇形的尾巴
适合突然加速去追捕猎物，但不适合快速、长距离的游泳。

鬼头刀鱼
金枪鱼
旗鱼
page_text_en:
Hmm? This fish's tail looks like a curved knife, so special!

The Wonders of Fish Tails

"Hmm? This fish's tail looks like a curved knife, so special!"
On the fish stall, fish tails come in different shapes. Dad says, marlin, tuna, and dolphinfish (scientific name: Coryphaena) have tail fins shaped like curved knives. They are swimming champions of the sea, faster than fish with round or fan-shaped tails, and can swim hundreds of kilometers in the ocean without getting tired.

Marlin, tuna, and dolphinfish are fierce carnivorous fish. They can catch prey at high speed or travel long distances in the sea.

When fish swim forward, they mainly rely on the movement of their tails. Therefore, different tail shapes affect a fish's swimming ability.

Curved knife-shaped tail
Suitable for fast, long-distance ocean travel.

Round and fan-shaped tails
Suitable for sudden acceleration to catch prey, but not suitable for fast, long-distance swimming.

Dolphinfish
Tuna
Marlin
summary_zh: 本页通过小女孩的观察和爸爸的讲解，介绍了旗鱼、金枪鱼和鬼头刀鱼的弯刀形尾巴及其在游泳中的优势，并对比了不同尾形鱼类的游泳特点，图文并茂地解释了鱼尾形状与游泳能力的关系。

title_en: Buying Fish at the Seafood Market
page_text_ocr_zh:
鱼的身体形状
“这条鱼好奇怪，它的身体和别的鱼不一样，是谁把它压扁了呢？”
卖鱼的伯伯说，比目鱼的身体都很扁，它们游不快，没办法追赶小鱼，于是它们就安静地躺在海底等待猎物靠近，经常趁小鱼不注意的时候冲上去捉住它。
看到猎物，我会快速弹起捉住它。
再沉入海底慢慢吃。
躲在平平的沙地上，不容易被发现。
比目鱼是身体呈扁平形的鱼，它们游泳速度不快，而且身体的颜色和海底的沙子、岩石的颜色很像，躲在平平的沙地上，不容易被发现。它们的眼睛长在鱼脸的同一边，是为了趴在沙地时能更好地看清楚猎物。
安全着地。
6/11
page_text_en:
Fish Body Shape
"This fish is so strange, its body is different from other fish. Who flattened it?"
The fish vendor says, flounder bodies are very flat. They don't swim fast and can't chase small fish, so they lie quietly on the seabed waiting for prey to come close, often rushing up to catch it when the small fish isn't paying attention.
Seeing prey, I'll quickly spring up to catch it.
Then sink back to the seabed to eat slowly.
Hiding on the flat sandy ground, it's hard to be spotted.
Flounder are fish with flat bodies. They swim slowly, and their body color resembles the sand and rocks on the seabed, making it hard to spot them when they hide on the flat sand. Their eyes are on the same side of their face, which helps them see prey more clearly when lying on the sand.
Land safely.
6/11
summary_zh: 本页介绍了比目鱼的身体特征和生存方式，通过小女孩和卖鱼伯伯的对话，解释了比目鱼身体扁平、眼睛长在同一侧的原因，以及它们如何利用伪装和突袭捕食猎物。

title_en: Buying Fish at the Seafood Market
page_text_ocr_zh:
▶ 圆柱形的身体
圆柱形的鱼，身体像一根粗粗的棍子，它们的身体很柔软，遇到危险时，可以快速逃跑，如海鲡。

海鲡

▲ 侧扁形的身体
大部分鱼的身体都是侧扁形的，平时它们游泳速度不快，但是遇到危险时，可以快速前进，逃离危险，如银鲳、刺鲳等。

银鲳
刺鲳

▲ 纺锤形的身体
纺锤形又被称作炮弹形，具有这种体形的鱼可以游得很快，也能游得很久，是水中的游泳健将，如黑鱼、金枪鱼、虱目鱼等。

黑鱼
金枪鱼
虱目鱼

◀ 长条形的身体
长条形身体的鱼，看起来很像一条长长的蛇，它们很会钻洞，所以多半生活在水底的泥沙或岩洞中，如白鳗和钱鳗等。

白鳗
page_text_en:
▶ Cylindrical Body
Fish with a cylindrical body are like thick sticks. Their bodies are very soft, and when they encounter danger, they can quickly escape, such as the saury.

Saury

▲ Laterally Flattened Body
Most fish have a laterally flattened body. Normally, they swim slowly, but when in danger, they can quickly move forward to escape, such as the silver pomfret and the spiny pomfret.

Silver Pomfret
Spiny Pomfret

▲ Fusiform Body
Fusiform, also known as bullet-shaped, fish with this body type can swim very fast and for long periods. They are swimming champions in the water, such as the black fish, tuna, and milkfish.

Black Fish
Tuna
Milkfish

◀ Elongated Body
Fish with an elongated body look like long snakes. They are very good at burrowing, so they mostly live in the mud or rock crevices at the bottom of the water, such as the white eel and the money eel.

White Eel
summary_zh: 本页通过图文结合的方式，介绍了四种不同鱼体形的特征及其适应环境：圆柱形、侧扁形、纺锤形和长条形，并举例说明了每种体形的代表鱼类及其生活习性。

鱼的颜色
“哇，这条鱼真漂亮！”
爸爸说，这条是鹦哥鱼，住在珊瑚礁区，身体的颜色很漂亮。还有一些鱼的身体是红色的，大多来自深海。它们虽然在光线下看起来是红色的，但是在黑暗的深海中，看起来就变成黑色的了。红色可是躲在黑暗的深海中最安全的颜色。
红目鲢住在深海里，喜欢在夜晚出来觅食，红色的皮肤是它绝佳的保护色。
这是红目鲢身体原来的颜色。
珊瑚礁区的鱼类色彩鲜艳，适合躲在彩色的珊瑚群中。
红色和红褐色的鱼，特别适合生活在深海里。红色的身体可以帮助它们安全地躲在黑暗的环境中。8/11

Fish Colors
"Wow, this fish is so beautiful!"
Dad says, this is a parrotfish, living in coral reef areas, with very beautiful body colors. Some fish have red bodies, mostly from the deep sea. Although they look red under light, they appear black in the dark deep sea. Red is the safest color for hiding in the dark deep sea.
Red-eye snapper lives in the deep sea, likes to come out to hunt at night, and its red skin is its excellent camouflage.
This is the original color of the red-eye snapper.
Fish in coral reef areas are brightly colored, suitable for hiding among colorful coral reefs.
Red and reddish-brown fish are especially suited to live in the deep sea. Their red bodies help them safely hide in dark environments. 8/11

page_text_en:
The World of Fish in the Sea
Going to the seafood market to buy fish is really fun. I never thought that by looking at the color, body shape, and tail of fish, we could discover the secrets of their lives in the sea. From now on, eating fish is not just eating fish, but more like reading a science storybook about fish. This book is not read at a desk, but on the dining table!

Salmon

Yellow croaker

Pufferfish

Sardine

Willow leaf fish

Cod

Flying fish

Today we bought yellow croaker, sardines, and salmon. What other stories do they have? Let me go home and read about them carefully!
summary_zh: 本页总结了前文内容，通过小女孩的视角，将海鲜市场买鱼的经历与学习鱼类知识联系起来，强调通过观察鱼的颜色、身体形状和尾巴可以了解其生活习性，并以餐桌上的鱼为引子，鼓励读者继续探索鱼类的科学故事。
